items.name: openlmis-form-actions
items.title: Form Actions
items.description: Cancel and Save actions for a form, with dirty and pending states, usable inside the form or in a page footer.

items.name: openlmis-settings-list
items.title: Settings List
items.description: Bordered setting rows with labels, descriptions, badges and editable or read-only values.

items.name: openlmis-date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A calendar date picker with date bounds, a clear button and accessible labels. Values stay in yyyy-MM-dd format.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-password-requirements
items.title: Password Requirements
items.description: A live checklist of password rules with pure validation helpers.

items.name: openlmis-table-selection
items.title: Table Selection
items.description: A page selection checkbox column and a floating selected-count bar with Clear and actions.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-combobox-filter
items.title: Combobox Filter
items.description: A searchable toolbar filter with caller-supplied options, search callbacks, status and empty messages.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-workspace-tabs
items.title: Workspace Tabs
items.description: Controlled page section tabs that wrap into a column or grid on narrow screens.

items.name: openlmis-pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pager for a server-paged list: rows per page, the range on screen out of the total, and first, previous, next and last page buttons, with a matching loading skeleton. Tightens to fit narrow containers.

items.name: openlmis-search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: Search field that reports after a pause in typing, on Enter or when it loses focus, with a clear button, so a list updates once per search rather than on every keystroke.

items.name: openlmis-select-filter
items.title: Select Filter
items.description: Toolbar dropdown that narrows a list to one value, reading "Status: Active" once picked, with a button to clear it.

items.name: openlmis-column-view-options
items.title: Column View Options
items.description: View menu that shows or hides a table's columns with checkboxes, and resets them to their defaults.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-status-badge
items.title: Status Badge
items.description: Badge for a state such as active, unsaved or ignored, in a success, warning, info or destructive tone with an icon of its own, so the state reads without relying on colour.

items.name: openlmis-page-breadcrumbs
items.title: Page Breadcrumbs
items.description: Breadcrumb trail from a list of steps, where a step without a page, such as a menu section, shows as text, and links render through any router.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-form-fields
items.title: Form Fields
items.description: Thirteen TanStack Form controls with stacked, row and inline layouts, accessible hints and errors, password reveal, searchable options, tags, images and dates, compact switch rows and radio cards or tiles.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-form-dialog
items.title: Form Dialog
items.description: Dialog for a form that stays inside the viewport and scrolls only its body, ignores clicks outside so nothing typed is lost, locks while a save runs, and shows save and load errors in place with a way to try again.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-dashboard-card
items.title: Dashboard Card
items.description: Card frame for a dashboard: a title with its count in a badge, a one-line description, placeholders and an error with Try Again for a body whose data is not ready, and a row that sets a wide card beside a narrow one when there is room.

items.name: openlmis-stat-strip
items.title: Stat Strip
items.description: One panel of headline numbers split by hairlines, with as many columns as there are stats, and a placeholder or Try Again for any number that is not ready.

items.name: openlmis-discard-changes-dialog
items.title: Discard Changes Dialog
items.description: Alert dialog asked before leaving a page with unsaved changes: how many would be lost and whose, Keep Editing, and a destructive Discard whose label says what happens next.

items.name: openlmis-callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: Message box in a warning, info or success tone, tinted border and background with an icon of its own and text in the foreground colours, for the states the stock Alert has no variant for.

items.name: openlmis-data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Server-paged table on TanStack Table v9: sortable headers, fixed column widths that hold steady from page to page, columns that drop when the table is narrow, a skeleton built from the real columns, empty and error states, and a pagination footer.

items.name: openlmis-role-assignments
items.title: Role Assignments
items.description: One role type's assignments for a user: search, sortable columns that fold into one on a narrow card, a role's rights in a popover, unsaved and ignored badges, removal and Add Role, plus the role types and helpers the user, roles and profile pages share.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-workspace
items.title: Workspace
items.description: Page frame for an app screen: breadcrumbs, a heading with an icon, title and one-line description, header actions that share the width when the header stacks, a content area, and a bar stuck to the bottom for page-wide actions such as Save.

items.name: openlmis-list-toolbar
items.title: List Toolbar
items.description: Layout for the controls above a list, installed with the search, filter and View menu it arranges: one row with room, and the search on a row of its own once the toolbar is narrow.

items.name: openlmis-profile-page
items.title: Profile Page
items.description: A mock profile with basic information, read-only role assignments, notification settings and a change password dialog.

items.name: openlmis-roles-page
items.title: Roles Page
items.description: Search and filter roles by type, create or edit them, and view their rights using local mock data.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-list-page
items.title: List Page
items.description: Complete users list screen on mock data: breadcrumbs and heading, a toolbar with search, a status filter, a View menu and Add User, a table with sorting, paging, empty and no-matches states, and row actions that open Edit User and Reset Password, with Add User going on to Set Password.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-home-dashboard
items.title: Home Dashboard
items.description: OpenLMIS home screen on mock data: a greeting with what is waiting, Add User, system notices, a stat strip, requisitions by period and by status, cold chain equipment and the approvals queue, each shown only when the user's rights allow.

items.name: openlmis-user-roles-page
items.title: User Roles Page
items.description: Edit User Roles on mock data: Supervision, Fulfillment, Reports and Administration tabs with counts over one draft, Add Role, Import Roles and View Rights dialogs, Remove with Undo, and Cancel and Save Changes in a bar at the bottom that asks before discarding unsaved changes.

items.name: openlmis-not-found-page
items.title: Not Found Page
items.description: A 404 page that shows the address that was asked for, with Go Back and Back Home, ready to render inside an app shell so the navigation stays.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-valid-assignments-page
items.title: Valid Assignments Page
items.description: Mock valid sources and destinations with paired facility and program filters, responsive tables, selection across pages, Add and partial Delete.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-system-settings-page
items.title: System Settings Page
items.description: Mock branding and feature flag settings with sticky Save and Cancel, discard confirmation, defaults, conflict Reload and partial-save feedback.
items.docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.

items.name: openlmis-number-text
items.title: Number Text
items.description: Pure number validation for text fields, including whole numbers, bounds and decimal precision.

items.name: openlmis-product-editor-page
items.title: Product Editor Page

items.name: openlmis-reset-password-page
